description: Run a file from `agent`'s scripts/ folder and return {name, exit_code, output}. On a Raspberry Pi a .py runs with the agent's Python and anything else with `sh`; output is its stdout (first 2 KB) and a run over 15 s is killed. On a Pico or ESP32 the file is exec'd in-process: output is what its read(*args) returns, or its `result`, and exit_code is 1 if it raised. `args` are letters and digits only.
name: mcp_script_run
